assumptions: Checkpoint shape metadata matches constructed modules before any tokenizer expansion.
Frozen ViT, token embeddings/lm_head and sinusoidal positions are excluded from trainable elements.
Direct model constructors leave persistent parameters in FP32; FSDP mixed precision casts compute, with full precision gradients for optimizer.
AdamW first and second moments are FP32 for trainable parameters with gradients.
One GPU provides no useful parameter-state sharding.
This is static budgeting, not measured peak memory; excludes VAE, activations, CUDA/FSDP workspaces, optimizer temporaries and possible gradient padding.
decision: Proceed to separately approved single-A100-80GB inference verification; do not launch default broad training unchanged. Partial freezing/PEFT adaptation requires its own approved implementation task.

external_references.supports: FP32 persistent parameters and default full-precision gradients outside mixed-precision compute.
FA2 baseline architecture and dtype support; no implication that Blackwell works with a pinned older build.
